title: Arena collision grid
description: arena/<name>/collision.yaml: the collision grid of an arena overlay, in the same form as a map's collision (map.schema.json), written by dwx extract (map_extractors.cpp: extractArenaCollision, formats/src/map/map_yaml.cpp: collisionToYaml). 100 x 100 cells; bit 0x80 = blocked, other values are trigger ids.

encoding.description: legend: one character per cell, looked up in legend; hex: two hex digits per cell.
